# Medical Outcomes Explorer — Complete Technical Reference

> Open healthcare analytics, hospital quality benchmarking, and FDA medical device post-market surveillance platform.

## When to use this

Use Medical Outcomes Explorer when:
- You need comprehensive, risk-adjusted US hospital quality metrics (CMS 30-day mortality, unplanned readmissions, patient safety composites).
- You want to evaluate Medicare financial penalty risk, including Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) excess readmission ratios, Hospital-Acquired Condition Reduction Program (HACRP) infection standardized ratios (CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI, CDI, MRSA), and Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (HVBP) domain baselines.
- You are conducting post-market surveillance on FDA medical devices (510(k) clearances, MAUDE adverse events, Class I/II/III recalls).
- You are qualifying clinical trial investigation sites based on academic research tiering, bed capacity, and specialty surgical volumes.
- You need open, reproducible healthcare datasets exported in structured JSON and CSV formats.

## Data Domains and Methodologies

### 1. CMS Hospital Quality & Outcomes
- **30-Day Mortality Measures**: Risk-standardized mortality rates for Acute Myocardial Infarction (`MORT_30_AMI`), Heart Failure (`MORT_30_HF`), Pneumonia (`MORT_30_PN`), Stroke (`MORT_30_STK`), Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (`MORT_30_CABG`), and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (`MORT_30_COPD`).
- **Unplanned Hospital Visits & Return Days (EDAC-30)**: Excess Days in Acute Care per 100 discharges following initial hospitalization.
- **Patient Safety Indicators (AHRQ PSI-90)**: Composite measure of in-hospital complications including pressure ulcers, perioperative pulmonary embolism, sepsis, and accidental puncture.

### 2. CMS Value-Based Programs
- **Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP)**: Measures excess readmission ratios (ERR). Ratios > 1.0 indicate higher-than-expected readmissions subject to payment adjustments.
- **Hospital-Acquired Condition Reduction Program (HACRP)**: Bottom quartile penalty program tracking Standardized Infection Ratios (SIRs) for CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI (Colon & Hysterectomy), CDI, and MRSA.
- **Hospital Value-Based Purchasing (HVBP)**: Incentive domain tracking clinical outcomes improvement from baseline to performance periods.

### 3. FDA Medical Device Surveillance
- **Premarket 510(k) & PMA Clearances**: Clearance decision dates, applicant histories, and advisory committees across 8 therapeutic areas.
- **MAUDE Adverse Events**: Manufacturer and User Facility Device Experience database reports categorized by event type (Death, Injury, Malfunction).
- **Enforcement & Recalls**: Class I (high risk of death or serious injury), Class II, and Class III recall tracking with root-cause analysis.

## Open Data APIs & Workbench

Download complete snapshot data directly from the client:
- JSON Export: Complete hierarchical clinical models.
- CSV Export: Flat tabular records optimized for statistical packages (R, Python pandas, Stata).
